title: Ilizwi Elivela Ngaphandle
intro: Umi kwisixeko apho abathunywa abathathu beze nemiqondiso ecacileyo, kodwa abantu bayabahleka baze babambelele kwiindlela zabo zakudala. Ukusuka kwiindawo ezikude zesixeko, umntu ubaleka esiya kwisihlwele, ephefumla kwaye ezimisele, ukuze athethe inyaniso nangona elahliwe. Ngubani lo mphefumlo obeke yonke into emngciphekweni ngenxa yesigidimi esingesiso esakhe?
clues: Ndihlala phakathi kwabantu ababefumene izithunywa ngemiqondiso ecacileyo, kodwa bona bajika ngekratshi.
Ndiphume ndibaleka ndisuka kweyona ndawo ikude yesixeko xa ndeva ngesimemo sabathunywa.
Ndathi ebantwini bam, 'Owu bantu bam, landelani abathunywa. Landelani abo bangaceli mvuzo kuni, kuba bakhokelwe kakuhle.'
Bendingengomprofeti, kodwa bendikholelwa kubathunywa kwaye ndibakhuthaza abantu bam ukuba benze okufanayo.
Abantu bam bahlekisa ngecebiso lam baza bandityhola ngokuba ngumntu othanda izinto ezingaphaya kwamandla omntu.
Xa bandibulala, uAllah wandixelela ukuba ndingene eParadesi, kwaye ndandinqwenela ukuba abantu bam bayazi intethelelo nembeko endiyifumeneyo.
